text.en:
Expanded Membership - The Office of the Presidential Adviser
on the Peace Process shall be included as a regular member of the NAPC.
POM) Hologram • 23603

Powers and Functions - The member agencies of the expanded
NAPC shall exercise powers and function as provided in Republic Act No. 8425.

Repealing Clause - All executive orders, issuances, rules and
regulations, or parts thereof inconsistent with the provisions of this Executive Order are
hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly.

Separability Clause - If any provision of this Executive Order is held
unconstitutional or invalid, other parts or provisions thereof, which are not affected
thereby shall continue to be in full force and effect.

Effectivity - This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
City of Manila,
2004
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
PGMA Hologram • 23604
